description: The Home Hub may store submitted temporary access codes, failed attempts, or associated access events beyond the period needed to validate the current unlock request. Retaining such data longer than necessary increases disclosure risk about guest visits and access behavior.

title: Guest may not be informed how entered access-code data is processed

title: Stored event history may be accessible more broadly than necessary
